label: Persistence of concrete GOD_4 presence from the standpoint (de dicto to de re bridge)
term: concrete GOD_4 presence persists from the standpoint
definition: GodPresencePersistsAt σ m w: for every x that is a concrete GOD_4 existing at w and every world v accessible from w, if some concrete GOD_4 exists at v then x exists at v. It asserts no existence and no uniqueness: other concrete GOD_4 may exist at w or at accessible worlds.
note: The de dicto to de re bridge of the modal ontological route: with reflexivity at w it turns the de dicto box of GodConcreteExists into de re NecessaryAt of the witness at w (necessaryGod_of_box_persists). Its warrant question is the cross-world stability of a concrete GOD_4: where the divine role is filled at an accessible world, it is filled at least by the same individual that fills it at w. Strictly weaker than the rigidity sibling GodPresenceRigidAt (persists_of_rigid; the fixedPlusVisitor control satisfies persistence and violates rigidity). Open; analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
